name: SikaFuko® VT-2
tagline: Re-injectable hose for sealing construction joints
summary: SikaFuko® VT-2 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction and connection joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko® VT-2 is injected with suitable Sika® Injection materials, such as acrylate and cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane and epoxy resins (for single injection). With the integrated ‘valve techniques’ the hose can be used to re-inject multiple times if necessary.

attributes: Multiple re-injections with Sika injection acrylate resins or cement lime/microfine cement suspension
One-time injectable with Sika injection polyurethane and epoxy resins
Ideal back-up system in combination with waterbars
Long-term references on many international projects
usage: Suitable for many different structures and construction methods where additional joint security/safety is required
Sealing of diaphragm wall (D-Wall) with SikaFuko® VT-2

Prevents water ingress through concrete joints in the following typical structures: Water retaining or excluding structures, water reservoirs, dams, canals, sewage treatment plants, tunnels, subways, retaining walls
As a back-up system for waterbars

packaging: Supplied as a Combi-pack in a cardboard box containing: 125 m SikaFuko® VT-2 8 m green PVC-hose (inlet) 8 m white PVC-hose (outlet) Accessories (2 m connecting pipe, 4 m heat shrink sleeve , x 50 closure plugs, 1 can of glue, 1 roll of tape, × 500 fastening clips) Also available as pre-fabricated, made to measure sections in special packs with accessories to suit for special projects (details on request).

items.label: Composition
items.text:
Yellow inner core | PVC
Yellow profile strips | Neoprene based cellular rubber
Mesh | Polyester

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Diameter
items.text:
Internal hose diameter | 10 mm
External hose diameter | 24 mm

items.label: System structure
items.text:
A | Injection channel
B | Solid hose core made of high quality PVC compound
C | Lateral grooves with staggered injection openings
D | Compressible neoprene profile strips (as ‘valves’) over the longitudinal grooves
E | Fine webbed nylon mesh for secure fixing of the neoprene profiles

items.label: Shore A hardness
items.text:
Yellow inner core | 85 ±3
Yellow profile strips | 20 ±5

items.label: Elongation
items.text:
Yellow inner core | ≥ 250 %
Yellow profile strips | ≥ 300 %
Mesh | ≥ 19 %

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.
